acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every table in §3 names its owner contract (C1/C2/C3/C4/C7 or B1-4b) and its data class from §4; no orphan table.
AC-2: The audit-from-first-mutation mechanism is specified precisely enough that B1-2 can write a test proving a mutation without an audit row fails.

AC-3: No column or blob stores raw device output; the provenance record schema in §5 is complete (all fields of workflow §3.5) and states what the UI may and may not claim about discarded raw content.
AC-4: Per-component secret scopes are enumerated with storage, rotation and outage behaviour; no shared application secret exists.
AC-5: §8 lists every PostgreSQL-specific construct used and its Oracle equivalent or the reason none is needed.
AC-6: §9 gives at least eight testable acceptance criteria for the B1-2 Flyway V1 movement.
AC-7: §10 lists every contradiction with frozen authority found while writing (or states none were found and which documents were checked).
AC-8: The document introduces no decision that UI2_0_BASELINE_CONTRACT.md reserves for the PO (RAW-RETENTION, DIRECTORY-POSTURE) -- those are referenced as decided/conditional, not re-decided.

baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_0_BASELINE_CONTRACT.md (FROZEN -- PRODUCT OWNER APPROVED 2026-09-09) binds direction and Phase 0 decisions: RUNTIME-DIRECTION (no Python in the UI 2.0 runtime), RAW-RETENTION default NO, FREEZE-SLICING (C1-C5 = platform freeze), DIRECTORY-POSTURE conditional, acceptance sentences A-1..A-3. docs/design/UI2_0_DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md (BASELINE rev 2) §3.5 (provenance record after discard_raw), §5 B0-1 scope, §10. UI2_0_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md §4 (shell boundary), §9 (storage: recorded, not re-derived; Oracle portability rules) and §10 invariants apply as amended by the brief §7 and workflow §2 (the F-ladder, main.py --worker and AG-U2's Python half are withdrawn).
baseline.sequencing: Runs concurrently with C2 (job execution contract, movement UI2_B0_C2_JOB_EXECUTION_CONTRACT). C1 owns the tables; C2 owns the job/lease/outcome semantics. Where C1 must name job tables, define only the columns C1 owns (identity, audit linkage, data class) and reference C2 for lifecycle columns by name -- do not duplicate C2's state machine. C3/C4/C5/C6/C7 come later and will reference this document.

context_not_loaded: Any Java source, Gradle build, Flyway migration file or Docker artefact -- B1 writes those against this contract
Line-1's utils/db_migrations.py and migrations/ as anything other than provenance: UI 2.0 does not share them (workflow P-1/P-4)
Device contact, credentials, network access of any kind
The identity/RBAC/session tables beyond the foreign keys C1 must reserve for them (C3 owns them)
invariants: Flyway is the ONLY migration authority for the UI 2.0 schema; no table is created or altered by application code, by Python, or by hand

RAW-RETENTION default NO: no column, table or blob stores raw device output; evidence rows carry a provenance record (run/step id, parser+capability version, capture/artefact id, source location, permitted sanitized fragment) per workflow §3.5

The audit table exists in migration V1 and every later mutation-bearing table is designed so that a mutation without an audit row is structurally impossible (state how: trigger, application-layer transaction rule, or both -- and which one is test-enforced)
Per-component secrets: the service, the worker, the scheduler and any adapter each have their own credential/secret scope; no shared 'app' secret; document storage, rotation and outage behaviour
Oracle portability rules from design §9 are preserved (no PostgreSQL-only types where a portable equivalent exists; name the exceptions)

Identifiers: device/cluster/context identities are opaque product identifiers; corporate hostnames/serials/IPs live only in fields the privacy law (PRIVACY_AND_DATA_HANDLING.md, DLP gate) classifies as such, never in log/audit free text
No decision already frozen in UI2_0_BASELINE_CONTRACT.md is reopened; contradictions with any frozen authority are REPORTED in a dedicated section, never silently resolved
